study type: Prospective, descriptive, three-phase mixed-methods study (qualitative interviews, survey)
outcome: preference for non-medically indicated caesarean section
cohort: Pregnant women attending an antenatal clinic in Thailand.
finding: Pregnant women in Thailand generally prefer vaginal birth, but physician recommendations, prior caesarean delivery, and advanced maternal age significantly influence their preference for non-medically indicated caesarean sections.
mod_finding: Although most women initially preferred vaginal delivery, a large proportion would consent to CS if advised by their doctor, and comprehensive counselling was found to strengthen women's confidence in choosing vaginal delivery.
